# Kitty interoperability fixtures

Generated by the real ratatui-image **11.0.6** / ratatui **0.30.2** code used by NakuruMusic, via `tools/fixtures/kitty-interop` (a separate development-only Cargo project; none of these dependencies enter congminal's runtime or main Cargo graph).

`ratatui-image-11.0.6.bin` contains that library's actual multi-chunk RGBA transfer and Unicode-placeholder terminal output, using its allocated image id. `.rgba` is the original synthetic 128x128 RGBA gradient, including transparent pixels. No user profile, account, network image or credentials are used.

Reproduce: `cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/fixtures/kitty-interop/Cargo.toml -- /tmp/ratatui-image-11.0.6.bin`. The congminal unit test feeds the bytes in 17-byte fragments, checks all decoded pixel bytes and all 128 placeholder coordinates/ids.
